rule: good. context only and never parsed; the three texts state the roosting habit, the exclusion and the Keepers' attitude on their own.
texts: good. the habitual becomes a fireable per-sky-cat rule, with the cliff-spires as the roosting site and the day carried as ordinary time-of-day information.
good. the blanket denial becomes the standard strength-zero rule over sky-cats, with the village typed outside the denial so it still exists.
good. "The Keepers" stays one named party rather than being split into individual keepers, and the tolerating event carries both participants.
